<!-- pr-reviewer: 2265849941b2c7462f796759a41c01124fd9e018 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (reviewed commit 22658499 only; #640's commit c7ab1602 was reviewed separately).

**What looks good**
- Corner math is right: `blade_corner` gives +1 (orientation 1, right, +Z), -1 (orientation 2, left, -Z) and 0 (6 and 9). The shift is `side * width / 2` along Z only, through #640's rigid `control_point_path`. X is untouched, and no nose-radius term is needed because a rounded corner's imaginary tip is the sharp corner.
- Orientation 6 still reproduces the old width-centre output (pinned at Z-10). The left-corner default for old projects (`default_for(Groove) = Some(2)`) is documented in the decision record, the PR body and the `.cps` header. A stated corner round-trips.
- Impossible codes are refused by name, listing `[1, 2, 6]`, with the operation and blade name (`posting_nose.rs` `checked_blade_corner`). A blade with no usable width is refused too.
- The cache, verifier and stock sim keep the true blade (a test pins that the cache stays at the centre).
- Golden change is confined to `fanuc-lathe/groove_part.nc`: the 2 mm groove walls Z-5.8/-4.6 move to Z-6.8/-5.6, the 3 mm part plunges Z-10 move to Z-11.5, and the tool note gains `ORIENTATION 2`. Every shift is exactly half the blade width. X is unchanged. No other golden is touched in this commit.
- Tests pin left, right and centre for both groove and part-off, the refusals, and undo/redo. No snapshot PNGs or `CHANGELOG.md` edits. No `build.rs`, `.github` or new dependencies. The only non-Rust asset change is a comment in `fanuc-lathe.cps`.

**Local results** (trial merge with upstream/main: already up to date, no conflicts; fresh worktree and target)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| lathe_blade_corner | 4 passed |
| lathe_nose_tip | 6 passed |
| lathe_post / g76 / refusals | 7 / 5 / 5 passed |
| lathe_field_sim / field_tools | 6 / 2 passed |
| lathe_stroke, spindle_fit, spindle_law, cross_drill | 5, 3, 8, 5 passed |
| turning, turning_blade, thread, form, bore, profile | 5, 14, 8, 8, 11, 6 passed |
| conformance | 6 passed |
| golden_cl | 23 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| project_roundtrip | 71 passed |
| commands_undo | 32 passed |
| camcraft-tools / camcraft-post (all targets) | all passed |
| ui orientation row (lib) | 1 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-tools --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. The Z-clearance retract also moves by the corner offset (Z20 to Z19 and Z18.5 in the golden). That follows from the rigid shift. It is harmless but worth a glance when hand-checking the program.
2. This is a program-moving default (all existing grooving/parting posts shift by -w/2 Z). The PR body and decision record say so; the release notes should repeat it for shops that touch off on the width centre.

Not exercised: a Hub run or real cut (the PR says the same).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
